info.title: Selwise Public API
info.description: The merchant-facing API of Selwise: the bootstrap config, campaigns, recommendations, search, event ingest, orders, identity, consent and enrichment. `x-selwise-tier` separates the stable integration contract (`integration`) from widget and app-SDK traffic that evolves with the client protocol (`widget`). Human-readable documentation: https://selwise.com/docs/api-reference/public-api

get.summary: Get variant assignments for a visitor

parameters.name: p
parameters.description: The `/config` protocol the client speaks (`CONFIG_PROTOCOL_CURRENT`), 1 when absent. A client below what an experiment's arms say or check (a placeholder in an override, a product condition, a variant module that needs more) is kept out of that experiment, in every arm.

parameters.name: capabilities
parameters.description: What the client can honour, comma-separated. `holdout`: an arm flagged `holdout` draws nothing. `audience`: the client applies an arm, and counts the visitor, only where its `audience` (the experiment's own page, device, country, behaviour, segment and test-mode rules) matches. A client that does not declare one is kept out of every experiment that needs it.

parameters.name: forceVariant
parameters.description: QA override, `<experimentId>:<variantId>`, repeatable. Bypasses the hash AND the traffic gate; the widget counts nothing for a forced arm.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: The visitor's language (`tr`, `en`…), matched to the account's languages; the default language otherwise.

channelApiKey.name: x-selwise-api-key
channelApiKey.description: A channel API key (`swpk_live_…`), created under Channels → API Keys. Each operation states the scope it needs in `x-selwise-scope`. On a WEB channel a browser request is authorised by its verified `Origin`/`Referer` instead, and when either header is present the key is not read at all — call from a server without them. An APP channel always needs the key. Purpose keys (`ssr_read`, `orders_write`, `newsletter_subscribe`, `business_events_write`, `reports_read`) are required whatever the headers.

message.description: For people. A program reads `code`, never this sentence.

code.description: Stable SCREAMING_SNAKE name on a coded error (`MODULE_NOT_ENTITLED`, `CHANNEL_NOT_VERIFIED`).

params.description: The values of a coded error.

example: events.0.name: name must be a string

placementKey.description: The named slot; an app places by name, never by selector.

html.description: Interpolated, sanitised markup for the whole rule.

css.description: Sanitised CSS scoped to the rule's blocks; `''` when none.

resolved.description: The catalogue carried the code (tokens resolved).

products.description: Array of products with their widget configurations

widgetId.description: Your own key for this entry. The response is keyed by it, so two entries for the same product (a view count and a cart count) each get their own answer.

config.description: Which count this entry asks for

accepted.description: False when the channel cannot run scenarios.

scenarios.description: How many published scenarios this event may start.

campaigns.description: Every campaign whose schedule window is open now (Europe/Istanbul), test-mode ones included.

sharedCatalog.description: The channel reads another channel's catalogue.

percent.description: Share of visitors held out of every surface.

channelId.description: Hashed with the visitor id to decide membership.

v.description: Digest stamp; changes whenever a rule or block changes.

slots.description: Selectors the widget watches for enrichment content (`s` selector, `p` position, `h` reserved height, `k` keys).

modules.description: Which modules the account has. A surface whose module is missing is sent empty.

widgets.description: Always empty: widgets merged into campaigns.

enabled.description: A scenario may deliver on-site: poll `/scenarios/inbox`.

error.description: Why `success` is false. The status is still 2xx.

clientAction.description: What the client should erase on its side.

index.description: Position of the entry in the request.

html.description: Merchant HTML; the widget sanitises it before it reaches the DOM.

css.description: Merchant CSS, scoped to the block's root by the widget.

placementKey.description: Only on the server-side render path.

order.description: Render order within a selector; ascending.

deviceVisibility.description: Only when the rule is for one device: `mobile` (a viewport below 768px) or `desktop`. Absent means every device.

v.description: Digest stamp; changes whenever a rule or block changes.

siteUserId.description: Logged-in user ID from the site

siteUserProfileId.description: Internal SiteUser profile ID (UUID) for merged behavior lookup after identify

deviceType.description: Device type: desktop, mobile, or tablet

segmentIds.description: Array of segment IDs to evaluate

isForced.description: Set by `forceVariant`; nothing is counted for a forced arm.

audience.description: The arm's own audience, judged by the client per page (needs `capabilities=audience`).

productCount.description: Products in the catalogue after the run.

productsUnchanged.description: Rows identical to the stored product; nothing was written.

productsRemoved.description: Removed because absent from a COMPLETE read.

catalogSignals.description: Price drops and restocks the run observed, for scenarios. Diagnostic; its shape may change.

country.description: ISO 3166 country from the edge's geo headers.

email.description: User email (will be hashed for storage)

pageUrl.description: Page URL where identify was called

userHash.description: Hex HMAC-SHA256 of externalId (or of "externalId:userHashTs") with the channel identity secret, computed on your server.

userHashTs.description: Unix seconds the signature was made at, when it signs "externalId:userHashTs". Valid for 7 days.

merged.description: The visitor's anonymous history was joined to the customer.

aliases.description: Visitor ids joined to this customer.

verified.description: The customer id arrived with a valid userHash (signed identity).

status.description: The order's new status, as the order system names it (`cancelled`, `refunded`, `returned`, `delivered`…). `cancelled`, `refunded`, `returned`, `failed`, `void` and `chargeback` take the order out of every revenue figure.

refundedTotal.description: Money refunded on this order SO FAR, in the order currency — the running total, not this refund alone. A value equal to the order total refunds it in full.

currency.description: The currency `refundedTotal` is in. When sent, it must be the order currency.

netTotal.description: `total - refundedTotal`: what the attribution panels count.

countsAsRevenue.description: False once the status takes the order out of revenue.

changed.description: False when the call changed nothing (a retry).

accepted.description: False when nothing was recorded: the visitor has not given analytics consent.

live.description: The visitor is counted live. A heartbeat only keeps live a visitor who sent an accepted event in the last 30 minutes; it never makes one live.

intervalMs.description: Send the next heartbeat after this many milliseconds.
Milliseconds between live heartbeats (`POST /presence`). Without this object, send none.

pending.description: Never set by the API (a client-side loading state).

isTestMode.description: Only shown to visitors in test mode (`?selwise_test_mode=1`).

contentJson.description: The type's content, in the visitor's language (`?lang=`).

devices.description: What differs on a phone (viewport below 768px): `{ mobile: { content?, styles?, placement? } }`, laid over the three objects above.

granted.description: Whether tracking consent is currently granted

orderId.description: Your order id: the de-duplication key on the channel. Sending `id` instead is a 400.

siteUserId.description: Your customer id (`identify`). Over 64 characters the order is kept and only the customer link drops.

currency.description: ISO 4217; the channel's currency when absent or invalid.

total.description: The sum of the items when absent. Two decimals, at most 99999999.99.

status.description: Lower-cased. `cancelled`, `refunded`, `failed`, `voided`, `declined`, `chargeback`, `returned` and their spellings keep the order out of revenue.

attribution.description: The client's last touch. Inferred from the session's events when absent.

experimentAssignments.description: Keyed by experiment id, to credit revenue to the arms.

skipPurchaseEvent.description: Store the order but write no canonical `purchase` event (the data layer bridge already did).

created.description: False when this `orderId` was already stored on the channel; nothing changed.

productItemCode.description: Must equal the feed `item_code`, at most 100 characters; otherwise product reports stay empty.

consentSnapshot.description: The visitor's consent, as on an event batch. Without analytics consent nothing is recorded.

visitorId.description: The browser or app install id, as on an event batch.

id.description: The feed row (`item_code`), the code the strip is keyed on.

_uuid.description: Selwise's internal id, for tracking joins.

cartCode.description: The code the basket accepts, when it differs from `itemCode` (Akinon: the numeric product pk).

complement.description: Only on a `complementary` strip: the role pair that put the product here.

variants.description: Buyable options: the feed's nested variants, or — with none — the group's sizes of this colour (`CardSizeOption`).

secondaryImageUrl.description: The image a card swaps to on hover.

liveCartRequired.description: The strategy needs the live cart in the products request (`cart`).

isTestMode.description: Only shown to visitors in test mode (`?selwise_test_mode=1`).

arrowStyles.description: Style settings the widget applies as they are. Their keys follow the dashboard builder.

dotStyles.description: Style settings the widget applies as they are. Their keys follow the dashboard builder.

titleStyles.description: Style settings the widget applies as they are. Their keys follow the dashboard builder.

subtitleStyles.description: Style settings the widget applies as they are. Their keys follow the dashboard builder.

containerStyles.description: Style settings the widget applies as they are. Their keys follow the dashboard builder.

pageTypes.description: Page kinds; empty means every kind.

productCard.description: The product card design this strip draws with (Design → Product Cards).

mobileProductCard.description: The card a phone (viewport below 768px) draws the strip with; null draws `productCard`.

devices.description: What differs on a phone (viewport below 768px): `{ mobile: { … } }`, a partial strip over its display fields (layout, product count, gap, autoplay, arrows, dots, titles and their styles, the container style), resolved over the rest.

reasonCodes.description: Why the strip is or is not eligible, for debugging.

code.description: JavaScript to run on the page.

email.description: The address typed into the registration form

phone.description: The mobile number typed into the form (E.164). Its permission is the same checkbox, but a placeholder number is dropped server-side.

wording.description: The label the shopper saw next to the box, verbatim. It is the consent evidence.

fullName.description: First and last name typed into the form

visitorId.description: Public visitor ID from the widget runtime

phone.description: Subscriber phone number (E.164, e.g. +905321112233). Required when channels includes "sms".

channels.description: Contact channels this signup opts into. Defaults to ["email"] when omitted.

visitorId.description: Public visitor ID from widget runtime

autoConnectUsers.description: Enable auto linking to SiteUser (default true)

eventSchemaVersion.description: Event schema version for strict canonical validation. Defaults to 1.

entityType.description: campaign | widget | recommendation | search | script | page | product | basket | checkout | user | custom

entityId.description: Entity ID - UUID for widgets/campaigns, or itemCode for product events, or string for other entities

productItemCode.description: Product itemCode (merchant ID) - PRIMARY identifier for all product events. Use this instead of productId.

name.description: Event name, e.g. impression, click, search_query, product_view, add_to_cart

metadata.description: Additional event metadata. For product events, include productItemCode here. Limited to 2KB.

correlationId.description: Correlation ID for linking related events in attribution

parentEventId.description: Parent event ID for event chains

journeyId.description: Journey ID at event level (separate from batch-level journeyId)

journeySequence.description: Position within journey (1, 2, 3...) for sequence analysis

endpoint.description: The browser's push service URL for this subscription.

currentProductId.description: The product being viewed (`item_code`), for a product-context strategy.

cart.description: The live cart, when the strip says `liveCartRequired`.

experimentVariantId.description: The experiment arm the visitor is in, when the strip is under test.

fallbackUsed.description: The strategy had too little and the fallback filled the strip.

reason.description: Why the strip is empty or fell back.

complementSetComputedAt.description: `complementary` only: when the precomputed set was computed.

stockCheckedAt.description: `complementary` only: when stock was re-checked for this answer.

error.description: Present when the products could not be read; `products` is then empty.

eventId.description: Your id for the event; a repeat is dropped.

orders.description: The previous window's orders and revenue are comparable.

events.description: Figures counted from the previous window's own events (visitors) are comparable.

attributed.description: Attributed figures are comparable: they need the interactions from a lookback before the previous window. When false, `previous.attributed` is null.

orders.description: Every live revenue order in the window.

attributed.description: Orders and revenue Selwise influenced; null when the window’s events are no longer stored.

action.description: accepted, declined, customized, timeout or api

available.description: False when the campaign can no longer be delivered; close it as `entity_missing`.

scenarioOnly.description: The campaign is not in `/config`; its body rides in `campaign`.

scripts.description: The scripts whose path rule matches `path`.

eventId.description: Your id for the event; a repeat is dropped.

productItemCode.description: The clicked product (`item_code`). Empty is a 400.

query.description: The query that led to the click.

journeyId.description: The visit (`journey_id`); resolved from the session when absent.

enabled.description: False when search is off (`mode: off`) or the channel never configured it.

mode.description: `test`: only browsers carrying the test flag draw it.

settings.description: The instant-search settings document (`SearchSettings`): placement (the field, what opens it, the desktop and phone surfaces), behavior (minChars, debounceMs, maxResults), results, suggestions, appearance, texts (in the visitor's language), cart, and `devices.mobile` — a partial document of what differs on a phone (viewport below 768px), resolved over the rest. Absent when the channel has no configuration.

mobileProductCard.description: The card a phone (viewport below 768px) draws results with; null draws `productCard`.

audience.description: Segment targeting: mode and segment ids.

_uuid.description: Selwise's internal id, for tracking joins.

currency.description: The channel's currency when the row carries none.

cartCode.description: The basket code when it differs from `itemCode`.

eventId.description: Your id for the event; a repeat is dropped.

hits.description: Card fields (`variants`, swatches) are added when the feed carries them.

enabled.description: False when search is off on this channel; `hits` is then empty.

redirect.description: The query matched a redirect rule: send the shopper here. `hits` is empty.

suggestions.description: "Did you mean" alternatives on a zero result (at most 5).

expandedQuery.description: The terms searched after synonym and Turkish inflection expansion.

error.description: Why the search did not run as asked. The status is still 200 — read it with `strategy` (`Query parameter required`, `Query too long`, `Search service temporarily unavailable`).

debugMeta.description: Diagnostics: the filters applied and what was clamped. Not for display.

traceId.description: Quote it to match a complaint with the server log.

recentSearches.description: A setting only: the shopper's own searches live in the browser.

popularProducts.description: Titles and URLs in the shopper's language (`?lang=`).

error.description: Set instead of the lists when reading them failed.

eventId.description: Your id for the event; a repeat is dropped.

results.description: Keyed by segment id: is the visitor in it.

v.description: Also the ETag; send it back as `If-None-Match` for a 304.

mode.description: Carries no visitor-dependent rule, so the rendered page may be cached.

slots.description: Keyed by placement key. A slot with no content is present and empty.

css.description: Every block's CSS, deduplicated and scoped; print it beside the content.

skipped.description: Why `products` is empty on purpose; null when the strip was answered.

cartCode.description: The code the basket accepts when it is not `itemCode`.

mode.description: Carries nothing visitor-dependent, so the rendered page may be cached.

title.description: Empty when the strip shows no heading.

html.description: Ready to print: interpolated, sanitised, scoped and wrapped in a stamped root.

success.description: False when the channel is unknown or unverified, or the write failed. The status is still 2xx.

testMode.description: Event came from a test-mode session

requestId.description: Client-generated request id for batch idempotency

consentSnapshot.description: Consent snapshot for this batch. Required; batch is dropped if missing.

journeyId.description: Journey ID for linking related events in a user session

testMode.description: The visitor has `selwise_test_mode` set. Only scenario entry reads it: a test-mode scenario must admit only a merchant doing QA, and nothing else on this path changes behaviour on it.

events.description: Array of events (max 200 per batch, subject to site config)

success.description: True only when every event was accepted.

degraded.description: Accepted events stored with a warning.

results.description: One entry per event, in no guaranteed order.

duplicate.description: Already received under this `eventId`; nothing was written.

degraded.description: Stored, but a field the reports need was missing (see `warnings`).

dataLayerConfig.description: Data layer settings: page-type patterns, tracking modules, cookie consent (Settings → Data Layer).

presence.description: The live heartbeat: whether to send it and how often (server-controlled).

geo.description: Per request; absent when the edge sent no country.

updated.description: Every key sent, written or unchanged.

widgets.description: Always empty: widgets merged into campaigns.
